import unittest
from subject import fixture


class VaultLockTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reentrant_and_released_normal(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.fallback_ready())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    def test_cache_moved_lock_held_and_released(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_reentrant_when_cache_moved(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    def test_reacquire_after_release_cache_moved(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            with s.lock():
                pass
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
